figures.caption: Table 1: Roundtrip equivalence and repair outcomes for 150 rules across three repair approaches and two models. Full repair achieves the highest final equivalence rate for both models. Claude benefits most from diagnosis: Full nearly doubles Random’s repair count (61 vs. 33) at 41 % lower cost-per-repair.

Figure 2: Unified framework: roundtrip autoformalization, verification, and repair. Top: the pipeline translates x through three independent LLM calls (T1, T2, T3). Middle: an SMT solver checks yorig ≡Σ yrt, where UNSAT confirms equivalence. Bottom: on SAT, the diagnosis function D identifies the first-failed stage i and produces a scoped explanation e. The corresponding repair operator Ri receives only the artifacts adjacent to stage i plus e (ensuring stage independence), then downstream artifacts are regenerated via the original T stages (green dashed) before re-verification.
